evidence.C1: Distinctive calm field-guide look with 'numbered plates' in Journal and 'field guide' side cards; tank art is the hero with 'depth haze' and 'fish floor shadows'.
evidence.C2: Main actions findable with big pill buttons, but the mobile fishing tooltip ('Flick up on the water...') obscures the interaction area, and 'Phone motion' label appears on desktop.
evidence.C3: Several interlocking loops exceeding typical apps: 'breeding with inherited colours', 'reef lab (frag, cross)', 'greenhouse trays', and 'focus timer' alongside fishing tournaments.
evidence.C4: Pixel-tidy with 'layered shadows' and consistent rounded corners, though the Garden 'Inventory' sidebar is text-heavy compared to the visual richness of the tank and journal.

fixes: Reduce opacity or size of the 'Flick up on the water' tooltip on mobile fishing screen, as it currently obscures the water surface where the gesture must be performed.
Update the 'Phone motion' toggle label on the desktop Fishing screen to 'Motion' or 'Mouse/Touch' to avoid confusion for non-mobile users.
Add small thumbnail icons to the 'Inventory' list in the Garden sidebar to match the visual 'field guide' style of the rest of the app and reduce text density.

evidence.C1: Coherent warm cream palette, glass-box tank with perspective panes and depth haze, field-guide journal with 'No. 01' plates and silhouettes, illustrated greenhouse bays. Fish art is the hero but vector fish read as somewhat simple/generic shapes rather than truly distinctive species portraits.
evidence.C2: Clear tools row (Feed/Care/Scape/Residents/Shop/Photo/Watch/Share), 'Have to do' checklist with explicit next steps, bottom nav consistent across phone views, Care sheet tiles are scannable. Phone layouts are not cramped; main actions are findable on every screen.
evidence.C3: Many interlocking loops: nitrogen-cycle care, 9-spot fishing with flick+reel+tension, breeding with inherited colours, 16-plant/8-hardscape scaping, greenhouse cuttings/variegated sports, reef lab frag/cross/named strains, journal dex with 47 species and 18 milestones, focus timer, koi pond with generative sound mix. Clearly exceeds a typical cozy aquarium app.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, floating white cards with layered shadows, unified typography and spacing across Tank/Care/Fishing/Garden/Journal/Focus/Pond. Nav states are consistent; feedback like 'Tap a fish to meet it' is unobtrusive. Minor rough edges: desktop side column feels slightly disconnected from the tank card, and some tile densities vary between screens.

fixes: Make the 47 fish species more visually distinctive in the tank and journal silhouettes — current vector fish read as similar generic shapes, weakening the 'field-guide' promise.

Tighten the desktop tank layout so the side column (water status, checklist, orders) feels integrated with the tank card rather than a separate stack — improve visual hierarchy and shared spacing rhythm.
Add more depth/texture to the koi pond water surface (subtle ripples, light caustics, varied lily pad shading) so the top-down view doesn't read as flat compared to the richly layered tank scene.
